records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our net revenues were $703.3 million, $488.3 million and $420.7 million in 2021, 2020 and 2019, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2021, revenues increased by $215.0 million, reflecting the strong demand conditions currently prevalent across the semiconductor industry, as well as market-share gains for our products in a broad range of applications including consumer appliances, advanced chargers for mobile devices such as smartphones, tablets and notebook computers, and a range of industrial applications including home-and-building automation, electronic utility meters, battery-operated tools and broad-based industrial applications.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: These disruptions have not materially affected our results due to a variety of mitigation measures including higher-than-normal inventories of wafers and finished goods in the early stages of the pandemic, safety stocks of certain key inputs, and multiple sources for components for most of our products.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: As a result, our unit costs and gross profit margin are impacted by the volume of units we produce.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In addition, in 2019 our cash generated from operating activities was favorably impacted by the settlement of our patent litigation with ON Semiconductor Corporation.
